final_review.interpretation: Tiny offline fit passed but task-level execution did not. First observable/actor/target inputs match and early errors grow; closed-loop deviation and error amplification is the single next diagnostic direction, not yet unique causal proof. Nonzero fitting errors, unobserved simulator state and target-block errors remain possible contributors. No new training/data/overlap/default change authorized by this review.
